screen.subject: 社内セミナーと精算書について
screen.line: 精算書：日付と標題を必ず記入

lines.en: Hello, and welcome to Kamaru Business Japanese.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Today is lesson 7: 25 words — internal documents.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: First, let's listen to an email from General Affairs.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Subject: The in-house seminar and the new expense-form procedure
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: To: All staff at every branch
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Thank you for your hard work. This is Sato from General Affairs.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: On the 10th of next month we'll hold an in-house seminar for new employees and junior staff.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Our lecturer previously handled PR at a company in the IT industry.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: On the day, they'll also show how to put together an advertising proposal, which was popular last year.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The managing director and the department managers will also talk about our plans going forward.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Next, about settling travel expenses. From this month, expense forms are handled in a new way.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Always put the date and a title on your expense form. How to fill it in is in the General Affairs manual.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Please also prepare invitation letters to clients in the same format as the manual.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: When you change the wording, take care that the intended meaning doesn't change.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Note that requests that are not urgent may be held over this month.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: If anything is unclear, please contact General Affairs.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Sato, General Affairs
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Now let's go through today's words one by one. First: company organisation.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: A company that does business to make money.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: There are many large companies in this area.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: A field of work that makes goods or services.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Japan's car industry is famous worldwide.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: Inside the company.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The in-house meeting is every Monday.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: A company office or shop away from head office.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I'll work at the Osaka branch from next month.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: General administration for the whole company.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: General Affairs handles ordering supplies.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: The department that does general administration.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Ask General Affairs for business cards.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: One of the senior executives of a company.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The managing director will attend the meeting.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: The head of a department.

lines.en: I submitted the report to the department manager.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: The people you work with.

lines.en: I settled my travel expenses for the business trip.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: The form you fill in to settle expenses.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Hand in your expense form by Friday.
lines.name: 例文

lines.en: The title of a document or text.

lines.en: Finally, let's check with a quiz. Choose the answer from 1 to 4.
